# dealim.net

> AliExpress deals whose discount is checked against each product's own 30-day price history. Updated several times a day in Hebrew, Spanish and English.

## Pages
- [Hebrew deals](https://dealim.net/he/): דילים מאליאקספרס שבאמת ירדו במחיר
- [Spanish deals](https://dealim.net/es/): ofertas de AliExpress con precio comprobado
- [English deals](https://dealim.net/en/): AliExpress price drops checked against 30-day history
- [Audio picks (Hebrew)](https://dealim.net/he/niche/audio.html): DACs, amplifiers and players from official brand stores
- [How prices are checked](https://dealim.net/he/how.html)
- [Feeds](https://dealim.net/he/feed.xml), [ES](https://dealim.net/es/feed.xml), [EN](https://dealim.net/en/feed.xml)
